comments.author: s1nk0
comments.body_html:
Go to your SPT aki folder and navigate to user\mods\SimpleRaidConfig\config and open config.json in a text editor.

At the bottom you should see

“lootMultiplier”: 1Change the number to whatever you want. So, if you want double loot:

“lootMultiplier”: 2Save and restart your server.
